# hookbase_webhook_subscription (Resource)

Manages a Hookbase webhook subscription linking an endpoint to an event type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Subscribe endpoint to order events
resource "hookbase_webhook_subscription" "acme_order_created" {
  endpoint_id   = hookbase_webhook_endpoint.acme_orders.id
  event_type_id = hookbase_event_type.order_created.id
}

# Subscription with filter and priority
resource "hookbase_webhook_subscription" "acme_order_failed" {
  endpoint_id       = hookbase_webhook_endpoint.acme_orders.id
  event_type_id     = hookbase_event_type.order_failed.id
  filter_expression = "event.data.amount > 100"
  priority_override = 0  # Critical
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint_id` (String) ID of the webhook endpoint. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `event_type_id` (String) ID of the event type. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `filter_expression` (String) CEL or JSONPath filter expression for event filtering.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the subscription is enabled.
- `label_filter_mode` (String) Label filter matching mode: all or any.
- `label_filters` (String) Label filters as a JSON object.
- `priority_override` (Number) Override delivery priority (0=Critical, 1=High, 2=Normal, 3=Low, 4=Bulk).
- `transform_id` (String) ID of the transform to apply before delivery.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Subscription ID.
